newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Foster's would consider Inntrepreneur bids.
newsitem.headline: Foster's would consider Inntrepreneur bids.

text.p: Foster's Brewing Group Ltd on Thursday said it would consider any offers for its half stake in the British pub chain, Inntrepreneur Pub Co Ltd (IPCL), which it saw as a non-core business.
"We have made no secret of the fact that ICPL is no longer a core business for us," chief executive Ted Kunkel told a news conference.
"We do get offers from time to time for different assets and we consider them ...," Kunkel said.
He did not say whether Foster's had been made an offer for IPCL but said Foster's would continue to rebuild the value of the business until an acceptable offer came along.
"I always said it was a long term hold while we rebuild the value in that company," he said.
Foster's has an option to buy out IPCL should its equal joint venture partner, Grand Metropolitan Plc, decide to sell.
GrandMet, which proposes to merge with Guinness Plc, has the same option in reverse. There has been speculation the merged group would want to sell out of IPCL.
